items.prompt: Pens cost Rp3.500 each. Hadi buys 4 pens and pays with Rp20.000. How many rupiah change does he get?
A notebook costs Rp7.500 and a ruler costs Rp2.250. Joko buys 3 notebooks and 2 rulers and pays with Rp30.000. How many rupiah change does he get?
hints: Find the cost of the notebooks and the rulers separately.
